authorization: User explicitly requested both renamed and public, accepting discoverability
sequence: Review audit and plan independently before mutation

Before mutation compare full metadata snapshot digest to surface-fingerprints.json, scan and fingerprint title/body/ID of issues/PRs/comments/reviews/commit-comments; check stable ID, branch/tag heads and Actions run IDs before EACH mutation; stop on unknown delta
Rename each using documented PATCH /repos/{current_owner}/{current_repo} name while private after GET repository ID assertion; read back stable ID/private/heads/Actions; no authenticated redirects

Publish via documented PATCH /repos/{current_owner}/{current_repo} private=false only after stable ID and content-only digest guard (title/body/ID unchanged across rename); verify anonymous public API and unchanged IDs/heads; app Actions remains disabled
Update common control origin and known independent clone origin, leave runtime source upstream unchanged
Adapt scoped current documentation/checker to canonical names with explicit trusted aliases; historical evidence stays byte-identical
Exact implementation commit review; sanitized scoped staging and final hook gate; push branch and Draft PR and verify actual CI
Read-only rulesets availability check; no merge/ruleset/enforcement or runtime changes
rollback_limits: Visibility/name can be changed back administratively; copies/forks/public disclosure cannot be undone
No history rewriting/deleting logs to conceal findings
Old PR HEAD snapshots do not gain new checker automatically; patch/stack acceptance separate
metadata_guard: Full JSON digest compared before any mutation, then protected content-only digest (IDs/title/body/user) stays identical across rename/publication; URL fields expected to transform are excluded, not arbitrary content.
additional_surfaces: Reviewer checking repository commit comments and PR head coverage; any new sensitive surface blocks publication.
